compose_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN weighted finite-state transducer graphs and verify the result
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring Viterbi path through a GTN graph and its score
union_concat_closure_graphs: perform union, concatenation, and closure operations on GTN graphs
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph to simplify its structure
